## Description

Preprocessing helper functions for the `lm` object in R [@RCoreTeam-2026]:
sample moments, standardized and selectively standardized
partial regression slopes,
R-squared and adjusted R-squared,
semipartial and partial correlations,
Cohen's f-squared,
and differences of slopes.

## Installation

You can install the development version of `processLM` from
[GitHub](https://github.com/ijapesigan/processLM) with:

```r
if (!require("pak")) install.packages("pak")
pak::pkg_install("ijapesigan/processLM")
```

## Example

```{r}
library(package = "processLM")
object <- stats::lm(
  formula = QUALITY ~ NARTIC + PCTGRT + PCTSUPP,
  data = nas1982
)
out <- ProcessLM(object = object)
out$beta
out$betastar
out$rsq
out$dif_betastar
```
